name: Douraku Yuusha - Mahobote no Utage
original_name: 道楽勇者 マホボテの宴
source:
The legions of hell are threatening the world. To combat this threat, the hero decides to make more heroes! Whenever he spots a girl he likes on his travels he uses a spell to instantly make them pregnant!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033979.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
地狱军团正在威胁世界。为了对抗这一威胁，英雄决定创造更多英雄！每当他在旅途中发现自己喜欢的女孩时，他都会使用咒语让她们立即怀孕！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033979.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
